## silex-forge v1.7.0

Public-ready **engine + Claude plugin** for team HTML artifacts on Cloudflare Pages.

### Highlights

- MIT license, CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY, CI
- Share/auth hardening (`vis:shared` + KV, scoped ops secret)
- Deploy injects Access / `PUBLIC_HOST` / Shlink vars from `forge.env`
- No infrastructure IDs in git (use `.env.example`)

### Install

```text
/plugin marketplace add go-silex/silex-forge
/plugin install silex-forge@silex-forge --scope user
```

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/go-silex/silex-forge/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for full notes.

**Before forking:** run [docs/public-release.md](https://github.com/go-silex/silex-forge/blob/main/docs/public-release.md) if you clone old history.
